name: home-assistant-mcp
description: Comprehensive Home Assistant visibility, automation management and administration for Claude, with two phase commit safety guardrails.
long_description: A full scope Model Context Protocol server for Home Assistant. It uses both the REST API and an authenticated WebSocket channel to search entities, inspect areas and services, render Jinja2 templates, create, edit and delete automations, scripts and helpers, read execution traces, check configuration and read logs. High risk actions (locks, alarms, climate, entry covers, major appliances, overwriting or deleting config, restarting Home Assistant) are rejected until the user explicitly confirms, and every config change is validated, backed up and reversible.

ha_url.title: Home Assistant URL
ha_url.description: Address of your Home Assistant instance, for example http://192.168.1.10:8123 or http://homeassistant.local:8123. Changing this takes effect after Claude Desktop restarts the extension.

ha_token.title: Long-lived access token
ha_token.description: Create one on your Home Assistant profile page under Security. Stored in your operating system keychain.

read_only.title: Read only mode
read_only.description: Only register tools that cannot change anything. Recommended for a first try.

control_only.title: Control only mode
control_only.description: Everyday use. Can read everything and switch lights, switches, fans, covers and media players, but cannot change automations, scripts, scenes, helpers, dashboards or settings. Ignored if Read only mode is ticked.

insecure_tls.title: Allow self signed certificates
insecure_tls.description: Skip TLS verification. Only for a trusted local network.

high_risk_entities.title: Extra high risk entities
high_risk_entities.description: Optional comma separated entity id patterns that always need confirmation, for example switch.workshop_*, light.pool_pump

never_touch_entities.title: Never touch entities
never_touch_entities.description: Optional comma separated entity id patterns that this server must never change, even with confirmation, for example lock.front_door, alarm_control_panel.*

require_approval_prompt.title: Require an approval prompt for high risk actions
require_approval_prompt.description: When on, high risk actions only run if Claude can show you an approval prompt and you accept it. Clients that cannot show prompts will be refused.

enable_config.title: Dashboards, registries, scenes, blueprints and integrations
enable_config.description: Tools to manage dashboards, areas, devices, labels, scenes, blueprints and integrations.

enable_insights.title: Insight tools
enable_insights.description: Home overview, problem finder, statistics, calendar, camera snapshots and similar read tools.

enable_raw.title: Raw API tools
enable_raw.description: Generic tools that can call any REST or WebSocket endpoint. Writes through them are still gated.

enable_supervisor.title: Supervisor tools
enable_supervisor.description: Add-ons, Supervisor backups and host info. Only works on Home Assistant OS or Supervised installs, not Docker.

ignore_unavailable.title: Entities expected to be unavailable
ignore_unavailable.description: Optional comma separated entity id patterns that find_problems and the overview should not report, for example light.*, switch.garage_*

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Keyword search across entity ids, friendly names, areas, devices and device classes.

tools.name: get_entity_details
tools.description: Complete inspection of one entity: current state, all attributes, decoded supported features, registry data (platform, device, area, disabled or hidden status) and the services available for its domain.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List every area (physical zone) with its id, name and the number of entities assigned to it.

tools.name: get_area_summary
tools.description: All devices and entities assigned to a physical area, grouped by device, with current states.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Expose registered service signatures.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: State changes for one or more entities over the last N hours, as a compact timeline.

tools.name: get_logbook
tools.description: Logbook entries (what happened and why) over the last N hours, optionally for a single entity.

tools.name: render_template
tools.description: Evaluate a Home Assistant Jinja2 template on the server through POST /api/template.

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Execute any Home Assistant service, for example light.turn_on or switch.toggle.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: List automations with their state, last triggered time, mode and config id.

tools.name: get_automation
tools.description: Read the full stored configuration of one automation through the Home Assistant config pipeline, together with its entity state and any high risk actions it contains.

tools.name: validate_automation_config
tools.description: Check a draft automation config without saving it.

tools.name: save_automation
tools.description: Create a new automation or overwrite an existing one.

tools.name: delete_automation
tools.description: Permanently delete a stored automation.

tools.name: get_automation_trace
tools.description: Inspect past runs of an automation to diagnose failures.

tools.name: reload_automations
tools.description: Reload automations from storage and YAML without restarting Home Assistant.

tools.name: list_scripts
tools.description: List scripts with their state, last triggered time, mode and config id.

tools.name: get_script
tools.description: Read the full stored configuration of one script through the Home Assistant config pipeline, together with its entity state and any high risk actions it contains.

tools.name: validate_script_config
tools.description: Check a draft script config without saving it.

tools.name: save_script
tools.description: Create a new script or overwrite an existing one.

tools.name: delete_script
tools.description: Permanently delete a stored script.

tools.name: get_script_trace
tools.description: Inspect past runs of a script to diagnose failures.

tools.name: reload_scripts
tools.description: Reload scripts from storage and YAML without restarting Home Assistant.

tools.name: list_helpers
tools.description: List UI managed helpers (input_boolean, input_number, input_text, input_select, input_datetime, input_button, counter, timer, schedule).

tools.name: create_helper
tools.description: Create a new UI managed helper.

tools.name: update_helper
tools.description: Overwrite fields of an existing UI managed helper.

tools.name: delete_helper
tools.description: Permanently delete a UI managed helper.

tools.name: get_ha_config
tools.description: Core facts about the instance: version, location name, time zone, unit system, run state, safe mode, and loaded integration count.

tools.name: check_config
tools.description: Run Home Assistant's configuration check (POST /api/config/core/check_config).

tools.name: get_error_log
tools.description: Fetch the tail of the Home Assistant error log, optionally keeping only lines that match a filter.

tools.name: get_system_health
tools.description: System health report per integration (Home Assistant core, supervisor, recorder database, and others), plus the core config summary.

tools.name: restart_home_assistant
tools.description: Restart Home Assistant core.

tools.name: stop_home_assistant
tools.description: Shut down Home Assistant core.

tools.name: list_backups
tools.description: List rollback backups taken automatically before automations, scripts or helpers were changed or deleted.

tools.name: restore_backup
tools.description: Roll an automation, script, scene, dashboard, helper or registry item (area, floor, label, device, entity, zone) back to a saved backup.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List all dashboards with their url_path, title, mode (storage or yaml) and sidebar settings.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Read a dashboard's stored configuration.

tools.name: save_dashboard
tools.description: Save the full config of a dashboard.

tools.name: save_dashboard_view
tools.description: Add a view to a dashboard, or replace the view with the same path (or title).

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a new, empty storage mode dashboard.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Permanently delete a dashboard and its stored config.

tools.name: delete_dashboard_config
tools.description: Remove a dashboard's stored config so Home Assistant generates it automatically again.

tools.name: list_registry
tools.description: List areas, floors, labels, devices, entities or zones from the Home Assistant registries, with an optional text filter.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Impact analysis.

tools.name: manage_registry
tools.description: Create, update or delete an area, floor, label, zone, device or entity registry item.

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: List scenes with their entity id, config id and last activation.

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: Read the stored config of a scene by config id or entity id, with the high risk entities it would change when activated.

tools.name: save_scene
tools.description: Create a scene or overwrite an existing one.

tools.name: delete_scene
tools.description: Permanently delete a stored scene.

tools.name: list_blueprints
tools.description: List installed blueprints for automations or scripts with their path, name, author, source and input names.

tools.name: import_blueprint
tools.description: Download a blueprint from a URL (GitHub, Home Assistant community forum or gist) and install it.

tools.name: delete_blueprint
tools.description: Delete an installed blueprint.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List configured integrations and helpers with their entry_id, domain, title, state and any problem reason.

tools.name: manage_config_entry
tools.description: Manage a configured integration.

tools.name: run_config_flow
tools.description: Drive Home Assistant's setup forms step by step, the way the UI does.

tools.name: list_repairs
tools.description: List the issues shown under Settings, Repairs, with severity, domain and whether each can be fixed or has been ignored.

tools.name: ignore_repair
tools.description: Mark a repair issue as ignored, or bring it back.

tools.name: get_home_overview
tools.description: One call snapshot of the whole home: version, counts by domain, who is home, locks and alarms, open entry covers, climate, lights on, unavailable entities (skipping the ones you expect to be off), low batteries, pending updates, automation counts, integration problems and repairs.

tools.name: find_problems
tools.description: Scan for things that need attention: unavailable or unknown entities (skipping expected ones), stale sensors that stopped reporting, low batteries, integrations that failed to load, open repairs, available updates, and optionally automations and scripts that reference entities that no longer exist.

tools.name: explain_state_change
tools.description: Why did this entity change? Reads the logbook and reports, for each recent change, what caused it: an automation or script (with the id to pass to get_automation_trace), a user or service call, or the device itself.

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Long-term statistics (hourly, daily, monthly aggregates that outlive the normal history), used for energy, temperature trends and any sensor with a state class.

tools.name: get_calendar_events
tools.description: List calendar entities, or the events of one calendar between two times (default: the next 7 days).

tools.name: get_todo_items
tools.description: Items on a to-do list entity such as todo.shopping_list.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Daily, hourly or twice-daily forecast from a weather entity.

tools.name: get_camera_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch the current picture from a camera or image entity and return it as an image, so it can be looked at directly.

tools.name: wait_for_state
tools.description: Wait until an entity reaches a state, or changes from its current state if no target is given, or the timeout passes.

tools.name: get_system_log
tools.description: Errors and warnings Home Assistant has logged, grouped with occurrence counts, source and the last message.

tools.name: ha_ws_read
tools.description: Send any read-only Home Assistant WebSocket command, for example lovelace/config, recorder/statistics_during_period, config/entity_registry/list, search/related, energy/get_prefs, repairs/list_issues or persistent_notification/get.

tools.name: ha_ws_write
tools.description: Send any Home Assistant WebSocket command that is not known to be read-only, for example config/entity_registry/update or lovelace/config/save.

tools.name: ha_rest_read
tools.description: Read anything from the Home Assistant REST API with GET, for example /api/calendars, /api/events, /api/history/period/<time>, /api/error_log or /api/config/scene/config/<id>.

tools.name: ha_rest_write
tools.description: Send POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE to the Home Assistant REST API, for example POST /api/events/<type> to fire an event or POST /api/config/scene/config/<id> to save a scene.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Recent calls to tools that can change Home Assistant, newest first, including previews and rejections.
